supersedes.schema: apply_week is redefined with the same signature and behaviour (CREATE OR REPLACE): it also reads the optional lunch_recipe_version_id / dinner_recipe_version_id of each day (an absent key keeps the slot link). Everything else is additive: tables recipes and recipe_versions, two nullable columns, FKs, CHECKs and a trigger on week_days, new functions. update_week_slot is not modified. No existing row is modified (links start NULL).
client: Week slots held only a dish title; the week page opened the title editor when a dish was tapped. Now each slot may point to an immutable card version (week_days.*_recipe_version_id) and tapping a dish opens its card.

No way to get ingredients, servings, time or steps of a dish. Now cards come from the catalogue (reviewed versions, none yet) or are estimated by AI on demand for one dish (/api/dish-card, saved with save_inferred_recipe and linked with update_week_slot_recipe), always labelled as not reviewed.
supersedes.rollout: The previous client keeps applying weeks and editing dishes with this migration applied: apply_week without the new keys keeps links, and a title change through update_week_slot or a direct week_days write clears the stale link (scripts/recipe-cards-db-tests.cjs, rollout scenario). Order: migration -> code (the new client reads the new columns; it falls back to the old columns if they are missing).

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.recipes_immutable()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE = '42501', MESSAGE = 'recipes: identity is immutable';
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.recipe_title_key(p_title text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT lower(btrim(regexp_replace(coalesce(p_title, ''), '\s+', ' ', 'g')));
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.recipe_allergen_keys()
 RETURNS text[]
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT ARRAY['gluten', 'crustaceans', 'eggs', 'fish', 'peanuts', 'soy', 'milk', 'nuts', 'celery',
    'mustard', 'sesame', 'sulphites', 'lupin', 'molluscs']::text[];
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.recipe_ingredients_issue(p_ingredients jsonb)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN jsonb_typeof(p_ingredients) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN 'ingredients_not_array'
    WHEN jsonb_array_length(p_ingredients) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 40 THEN 'ingredients_count'
    WHEN octet_length(p_ingredients::text) > 12000 THEN 'ingredients_size'
    WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_ingredients) AS i(item)
      WHERE jsonb_typeof(i.item) IS DISTINCT FROM 'object'
        OR (SELECT array_agg(k ORDER BY k) FROM jsonb_object_keys(i.item) AS k)
           IS DISTINCT FROM ARRAY['category', 'name', 'optional', 'quantity', 'unit']
        OR jsonb_typeof(i.item -> 'name') IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
        OR char_length(btrim(i.item ->> 'name')) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 80
        OR jsonb_typeof(i.item -> 'quantity') NOT IN ('number', 'null')
        OR (jsonb_typeof(i.item -> 'quantity') = 'number'
            AND ((i.item ->> 'quantity')::numeric <= 0 OR (i.item ->> 'quantity')::numeric > 100000))
        OR jsonb_typeof(i.item -> 'unit') NOT IN ('string', 'null')
        OR (jsonb_typeof(i.item -> 'unit') = 'string' AND char_length(btrim(i.item ->> 'unit')) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 20)
        OR (i.item ->> 'category') IS NULL
        OR (i.item ->> 'category') NOT IN ('frutería', 'carnicería', 'pescadería', 'lácteos', 'despensa', 'congelados', 'otros')
        OR jsonb_typeof(i.item -> 'optional') IS DISTINCT FROM 'boolean'
    ) THEN 'ingredient_invalid'
    ELSE NULL
  END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.recipe_steps_issue(p_steps jsonb)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN jsonb_typeof(p_steps) IS DISTINCT FROM 'array' THEN 'steps_not_array'
    WHEN jsonb_array_length(p_steps) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 20 THEN 'steps_count'
    WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(p_steps) AS s(step)
      WHERE jsonb_typeof(s.step) IS DISTINCT FROM 'string'
        OR char_length(btrim(s.step #>> '{}')) NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 400
    ) THEN 'step_invalid'
    ELSE NULL
  END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.recipe_content_hash(p_base_servings integer, p_total_minutes integer, p_ingredients jsonb, p_steps jsonb, p_allergens text[])
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE PARALLEL SAFE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT 'rc1:' || md5(jsonb_build_object(
    'baseServings', p_base_servings,
    'totalMinutes', p_total_minutes,
    'ingredients', p_ingredients,
    'steps', p_steps,
    'possibleAllergens', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(DISTINCT a ORDER BY a) FROM unnest(p_allergens) AS a), '[]'::jsonb)
  )::text);
$function$

triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER recipe_versions_guard BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.recipe_versions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION recipe_versions_guard()
CREATE TRIGGER recipes_immutable BEFORE UPDATE ON public.recipes FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION recipes_immutable()
